title: Low Carb Chicken Piccata
conventions: buy strings are cook measures (what goes in the pot), grams derived FROM the printed measure via db\densities.json so the two agree by construction; quantities quantized to house quarters, drift over 5% noted per line.

ruled_substitutions.from: (no fat listed for the fry step)
ruled_substitutions.to: Olive Oil, 7 tbsp scaled (1 tbsp per source batch), ADDED
ruled_substitutions.basis: Source step 4 says 'Fry the chicken breasts' but the printed list carries no frying fat (the 1 tbsp butter is consumed later by the sauce, step 6-7; the extractor flagged the same). The card is not executable without it, and the source's own published calories arbitrate the amount: our no-oil recompute is 408 cal/serving vs the published 465, and adding 1 tbsp oil per 2-serving source batch lands at 467.5 (+0.5% vs published) - the source's calculator almost certainly counted this oil. 1 tbsp per two cutlets is also the physical minimum for a shallow fry. Documented as an addition, not silently blended.

ingredients.notes: Main protein on a COUNT, so the each-weight is the danger line (florentine failure mode) - checked against the source's own label. House each = 200 g -> 2800 g = 200 g raw per serving. Published 60 g protein/serving implies ~215 g chicken/serving after crediting the parmesan (~10 g) and broth (~0.5 g); our 200 g booking computes 55.6 g (-7.3%), inside the 15% instrument, while a small 113 g cutlet would compute 36 g (-40%, BREAK) and is refuted. Catalog average is 167 g/serving; 200 g sits high but is what the published label supports. Board 6 of 7, cheapest Baker's $1.99/lb.

macro_cross_check.verdict: PASS: protein -7.3% (inside the 15% instrument) and calories +0.5% once the ruled frying-oil addition is included; without it the recompute is 408 cal (-12.3%), which is the fingerprint of the missing oil, not of a wrong portion. Fat runs +31% high and carbs -40% low against the published label, but the published label is internally loose (its own macros sum to ~447 cal against its printed 465) and protein is the instrument; the 200 g each-weight on the main protein is affirmatively supported by the published 60 g protein figure. Also note step 10 mentions parsley that is in no ingredient list; left out as garnish-only, zero stakes.
macro_cross_check.band_check: computed 467.5 cal in [400, 650] PASS (67 above the floor, 182 below the ceiling); carbs 5.4 g <= 35 PASS. Caveat: WITHOUT the ruled oil the recipe sits at 408.0 cal, only 8 above the floor - if spec/QA strips the ruled addition, the floor margin nearly vanishes.

board_defects_observed: butter and paprika exist on BOTH boards' rule sets; this file books board='recipe' per the stated membership rule (id present in recipe-commodities.json), but creamy-tuscan-chicken-skillet booked both as 'weekly'. One convention should win at the gate; flagged, not silently harmonized.
